intent: Extended sensor positions further to the left and right edges of the tape to improve coverage and reduce line loss events on the slalom track, while maintaining larger sensor size and wider wheel track/body width for stability. Expect improved line detection at tape edges, fewer off-track terminations, and better overall performance on challenging tracks.
rationale: The previous iteration's geometry increased sensor size to 0.016 m and widened the wheel track and body width to 0.16 m, improving stability and off-track tolerance. However, the robot still failed to complete the slalom track, with off-track terminations and line loss events mainly at tape edges. Telemetry indicates insufficient sensor coverage at the tape edges, causing line loss and off-track events. To address this, I propose extending the sensor positions further towards the tape edges to improve coverage, while maintaining the 5-sensor layout, sensor size at 0.016 m, wheel track at 0.16 m, and body width at 0.16 m for stability. Wheel radius and body length remain unchanged to preserve speed and agility. I expect this adjustment to reduce line loss events on the slalom track, improve line detection at tape edges, and enhance overall completion and error metrics, especially on challenging tracks.
